caption: Eiger, Grindelwald
composition: Grindelwald meadows looking south at the Eiger north face · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the Grindelwald valley, the Eiger’s north face is a dark, near-vertical wall, with the Mönch and Jungfrau further west and the Wetterhorn to the east. Meadows and wooden chalets sit in the foreground under late-September green. The Open-Meteo valley model is overcast with partial cloud cover, so the upper wall carries cloud while the face stays identifiable. No climbing infrastructure is invented on the wall.
